graders.name: verification-surface-merge-gate
graders.instruction: At the merge gate confirm two things, blocking the merge if either fails. (1) No assertion in test_submit_zero_commit_done_cleans_up or test_submit_uncommitted_done_parks was deleted or weakened without a named, equal-or-stronger replacement among criteria 3-6 (a removed assertion with no named replacement is a blocking defect). (2) The identity checks (criteria 1, 2), the scrubbed-host merge check (criterion 6), and the landing-parked-event checks (criteria 4, 5 -- which read store.list_domain_events(run_id) for the LANDING_PARKED kind and park_kind=uncommitted-work, never git markers or stderr) are graded by held-out tests under .flywheel/holdout/00027-worktree-commit-integrity/ that the implementing agent did not author against its own fixtures, run out-of-band -- not by tests the agent wrote against its own known inputs. Also confirm the flywheel-core event/serde/store tests stay green and schema_version is still 12 (the LANDING_PARKED kind is additive opaque JSON, no migration -- SI-9, D-6).

goal: On a host with no global or system git identity, a clean DONE run carrying real commits FF-merges into the base and is cleaned up, and the full existing worktree suite still passes at or above its pre-change test count.

relevant: packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- the FF-merge + cleanup happy path inside _submit (the commit_count > 0 branch through _ff_merge and _cleanup) that must survive on a scrubbed host once the upstream identity + classification tasks land.

packages/flywheel-worktree/tests/test_worker.py -- the full existing suite (test_submit_ff_merges_on_done, the run_once integration test, every prepare/submit test); it must still collect and pass with no test deleted or weakened.

packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_events.py, test_events_module_purity.py, test_store_contract.py -- per D-6 this feature now also touches flywheel_core.events (the LANDING_PARKED kind + event_serde round-trip + ledger persistence); the full-suite-green grader must keep these green and schema_version must stay 12 (no migration).

.flywheel/specs/00027-FEATURE-worktree-commit-integrity.md -- criteria 6, 8, 9; D-6 (park = store domain-event append, supersedes D-2; the verification surface now spans flywheel-core); the Verification-surface section; Decomposition Layer C
constraints: This task should require little or no production code beyond what the two prerequisite tasks land -- it is the composition holdout that proves identity + commit + classification + FF-merge compose on a scrubbed host (criterion 6) without breaking the existing FF-merge/cleanup happy path. If a real source change is needed to keep the seam green, make it here and commit it.

The 'suite intact' grader must observe that the existing worktree suite still collects strictly more than zero tests and passes; deleting or weakening the existing park/no-op/merge tests to make new criteria pass is the defect criterion 8 forecloses.
Commit any change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do not modify the held-out grading surface under .flywheel/holdout/00027-worktree-commit-integrity/; do not delete or weaken any test under packages/flywheel-worktree/tests/.
Do not change the FF-merge / rebase / re-verify landing semantics or the protected-path refusal (spec 00026's TAIL); criterion 6 asserts the EXISTING happy path survives, not that it changes.
Do not introduce new park or no-op behavior here -- that is the prerequisite classification task's scope.
edge_cases: An identity fix that lets commits happen but silently breaks the FF-merge/cleanup happy path on a scrubbed host is the regression criterion 6 catches: assert rev-list --count base..HEAD advanced by the commit count, the worktree is gone, and the task branch ref is absent.
A submit-side change that makes the new criteria pass by removing test_submit_zero_commit_done_cleans_up or test_submit_uncommitted_done_parks must fail the suite-intact floor and the manual gate.
notes: The held-out grader runs `uv run pytest .flywheel/holdout/00027-worktree-commit-integrity/ -k clean_commit_ff_merges` (authored out-of-band by fw-verify under the same scrubbed-identity fixture as criteria 1 and 2). That path is outside the four pytest testpaths; the grader passes it explicitly, so a bare `uv run pytest` (the full-suite grader) never collects the held-out tests -- the two graders are independent surfaces. Criterion 9 is the manual verification-surface gate paired with the held-out command checks; it is the only non-command grader in the plan.
